title: Connections
descriptionAfter: . Connect or disconnect accounts, see health and reconnect status.
smartBar: This is the hub for all data into the app — without connections, Messages, Content and Insights stay empty.
step1: Connect the channels you work with (mail, social, reviews…)
step2: Check status — yellow/red means you need to reconnect or sync
step3: Use the connections across the rest of the app (publish, reply, report)
tip: After connecting: fill in Company (description + website) so AI and automations get the right context. Health shows issues in one place.
healthHint_one: {{count}} connection needs attention — open the Health tab
healthHint_other: {{count}} connections need attention — open the Health tab

fix.reauth: Reconnect and sign in again to renew the OAuth token.
fix.pending: Sync in progress — try again in a moment.
